audit_metadata.overall_gate_status: EXP-06 DEVELOPMENT/VALIDATION ACCEPTANCE: PASS — CERTIFIED & CLOSED WITHIN THE AUDITED PHASE 5H SCOPE.

gates.name: Validation Recall
gates.original_contract_section: Section 2 (Falsification Condition 1) & Section 6 (Pre-Registered Acceptance Gates Table)
gates.definition: Global Part I validation pixel recall at fixed operating threshold tau=0.22

gates.name: Validation IoU
gates.original_contract_section: Section 2 (Falsification Condition 2) & Section 6 (Pre-Registered Acceptance Gates Table)
gates.definition: Global Part I validation Intersection-over-Union at fixed operating threshold tau=0.22

gates.name: Clean-Water FAR
gates.original_contract_section: Section 2 (Falsification Condition 3) & Section 6 (Pre-Registered Acceptance Gates Table)
gates.definition: Percentage of empty validation tiles (GT positive pixels == 0) having at least 1 false positive pixel at tau=0.22
gates.formula: (count(empty tiles with fp >= 1) / total empty tiles) * 100.0

gates.name: Significant FAR
gates.original_contract_section: Section 2 (Falsification Condition 3) & Section 6 (Pre-Registered Acceptance Gates Table)
gates.definition: Percentage of empty validation tiles (GT positive pixels == 0) having at least 100 false positive pixels at tau=0.22
gates.formula: (count(empty tiles with fp >= 100) / total empty tiles) * 100.0

gates.name: Clean-Water FP Pixels (Empty Validation Tiles)
gates.original_contract_section: Section 2 (Falsification Condition 4) & Section 6 (Pre-Registered Acceptance Gates Table)
gates.original_wording: Total FP pixels on empty validation tiles rises to >= 350,000 pixels / Total FP Pixels (Empty) < 350,000
gates.definition: Sum of false positive pixels strictly on the 1,827 empty validation tiles (GT positive pixels == 0) at tau=0.22

total_validation_fp_pixels.definition: Global FP in confusion matrix: sum of false positive pixels across both empty tiles and positive slick tiles

clean_water_fp_pixels.population: 1,827 empty Part I validation tiles (clean ocean)
clean_water_fp_pixels.definition: Sum of false positive pixels on empty validation tiles (zero GT positive pixels)

slick_tile_fp_pixels.population: 1,053 positive Part I validation tiles (containing oil slicks)
slick_tile_fp_pixels.definition: Sum of false positive pixels on tiles with oil slicks (1,053 slick-containing validation tiles)

clean_water_vs_significant_far_forensic.explanation_of_equality: Clean-Water FAR and Significant FAR are distinct metrics. They happen to be numerically equal for the final EXP-06 checkpoint because the same 10 empty validation tiles satisfy both false-alarm conditions (all 10 false-positive empty validation tiles contained at least 100 false-positive pixels). In earlier epochs (Epoch 1: 13.52% vs 9.63%; Epoch 2: 6.13% vs 4.43%; Epoch 5: 0.82% vs 0.77%), the two metrics produced distinct values as designed.
